post.description: The assistant looks up the catalogue and the orders of whoever asks (only theirs) with its tools. With Accept: text/event-stream, the answer arrives streamed, piece by piece, as the model writes it.

200.description: The assistant's answer and the tokens it cost: whole (application/json) or streamed (text/event-stream, with Accept: text/event-stream)

schema.description: "text" events (data: {"text": "…"}, one more piece of the answer; together, in order, they are the whole answer), a "tool" event each time the assistant is about to use one (data: {"name": "search_products", "label": "Searching products…"}, the label to show meanwhile), an "end" event when it finishes (data: an AssistantAnswer, the same as in JSON; if refused is true, its text replaces what arrived before) and, if something fails halfway, an "error" event (data: a Problem) instead of "end". After "end" or "error", the stream closes.
